preconditions.description: Each string in the input list is composed of exactly two words.

postconditions.description: The returned list is sorted by the last names of the reindeer.
The length of the returned list is the same as the length of the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(reindeer_names[i] == return_value[i] for i in range(len(reindeer_names)) if reindeer_names[i].split()[1] == return_value[i].split()[1])
postconditions.description: In case of identical last names, the original order is preserved.
